tasks.title: 同步 Lean AI Software Delivery 产品真源
tasks.goal: 把面向高效 AI 软件交付的定位、反过度设计问题、生命周期模式、工具组合、指标与退役边界合并到既有唯一产品真源。
implementation_steps: 补充问题、JTBD、FR/NFR 与指标
定义 advisory 架构、责任 lens 和 ADR
增加 M0-M3 条件性路线
同步产品索引与 truth boundary
rollback: 只撤销四个产品文档的 maintenance 增量和共享 evidence 对应记录
done_when: 既有产品文档仍为唯一产品真源
P5/P6 状态未改变
设计态能力未被描述为 runtime/live 实现

tasks.title: 落盘 maintenance spec、实施计划与 checklist
tasks.goal: 建立 PRD 到架构、spec、plan、task、verifier 的非 Phase 可执行追踪，同时保留 P5 current-phase truth。
preconditions: maintenance track is not a Phase
implementation_steps: 按固定二十章定义 spec
建立四任务 manifest 与依赖
为 plan 增加 ordered work/checkpoint
为 todo 增加一次性状态镜像
rollback: 删除 maintenance spec/manifest 并撤销 plan/todo 独立章节，不修改 P5 资产
done_when: 四个任务字段完整且无环
plan/todo 各引用每个 maintenance task 一次
pilot 未进入当前 manifest

tasks.title: 实现 maintenance planning verifier 与单元测试
tasks.goal: 以只读 companion verifier fail-close maintenance planning 漂移，并通过最小文件 fixtures 证明关键负向边界。
implementation_steps: 先调用 P5 planning verifier
实现 manifest/cross-reference/write-set/truth checks
实现 stable JSON and exit contract
增加 current and negative fixtures
rollback: 删除 companion verifier/tests；原 P5 verifier 继续独立有效
done_when: current repo has zero maintenance findings
all planned negative cases emit deterministic finding codes
verifier performs no writes/network/host access

tasks.title: 同步根契约、共享 evidence 并完成有序收口
tasks.goal: 把非 Phase 维护真源登记到根契约，以一份逻辑切片 evidence 和唯一 full gate 收口，并保持 P5/P6/pilot/live 边界。
preconditions: all planning assets and focused tests complete
implementation_steps: 登记 maintenance truth without copying full design
记录 source/write-set/disposition/truth boundary
运行 ordered build/focused/contracts/full
同步 done 状态并复核 Git boundary
rollback: 只撤销本 track 文件和增量；P5 manifest/spec/evidence、runtime/config/host 状态保持不变
done_when: four maintenance tasks done with shared evidence
new and old planning verifiers pass
maintenance design planning package is repo_verified only

tasks.title: 固化 host-owned coordinator、write-set admission 与 Git freshness 语义
tasks.goal: 把只读设计 panel、单一结果 owner、disjoint worktree、shared seam 单 writer、lease recovery 与 Git CAS/hash 的真实能力边界写成 AI 可执行合同。
preconditions: host native agent/worktree remains execution owner
no community runtime installation is authorized
implementation_steps: 记录 design-only panel 与 coordinator ownership
定义 write-set admission 和 lease revoke/reassign
澄清 Git ref CAS、file hash 与 merge conflict 均不是文件队列
定义 candidate integration 和局部/整体 truth boundary
tests: required FR/ADR identifiers are unique and referenced
shared-write and Git-CAS negative claims are represented
rollback: 只撤销 M0.2 coordinator/write-set/Git 规划增量，不修改 P5/M0 历史资产或宿主状态
done_when: coordinator and integration owner are explicit
shared paths default to single_writer
Git CAS is documented as freshness rather than file queue
no coordinator or lease runtime is introduced

tasks.title: 固化稀疏工具栈、社区 disposition 与 M1 observation contract
tasks.goal: 为 skill/plugin/MCP/knowledge/code-graph 候选建立证据化 adopt/adapt/defer/reject、准入、回放、退役和 M1 观察字段，不增加第二个 registry。
preconditions: community sources are treated as untrusted read-only inputs
no tool install or provider call is authorized
implementation_steps: 定义 ToolDispositionView 字段和 surface map
记录 Trellis/AGOS/OptSkills/GBrain/code graph/unknown source disposition
定义 external context adapter two-real-task admission
为现有 M1 sample 增加 coordination/tool/skill observations
tests: pilot registry observation dimensions are exact
sample observation enums and tool dispositions fail closed
community candidates remain reference/defer without runtime claims
rollback: 撤销 M0.2 tool/observation 增量，保留既有 M1 categories/counting/status 与 M0 evidence
done_when: every tool kind has one stable responsibility
context adapters require two independent real failures and safety evidence
skill lifecycle includes negative sample and retirement
M1 remains collecting 0/10

tasks.title: 增强 maintenance verifier 的 M0.2 与 evidence-group 门禁
tasks.goal: 让 companion verifier 按逻辑切片检查 evidence group，并阻断缺失 M0.2 任务、错误 CAS/共享写入语义、控制面偷渡、adapter admission 漂移和不完整 sample observations。
preconditions: M0.2 identifiers and registry fields are stable
implementation_steps: require evidence_group and exact M0/M0.2 task IDs
validate shared evidence within each group
require M0.2 policy literals
validate observation dimensions/enums
add current and focused negative fixtures
tests: missing evidence group or evidence file fails
rollback: 回滚 M0.2 verifier/tests/manifest 增量；原 M0/P5 verifier 和历史 evidence 继续独立有效
done_when: eight maintenance tasks and two evidence groups validate
M0.2 policy drift returns deterministic finding codes
pilot observation drift fails closed
verifier performs no writes/network/host access

tasks.title: 同步 M0.2 状态、证据并完成有序收口
tasks.goal: 把 M0.2 规划真值同步到产品索引、plan/todo 与根契约，以独立 reviewed evidence 和唯一 full gate 收口，同时保持 M1/P6/runtime/live 边界。
preconditions: SMV-MD-005 through SMV-MD-007 pass focused verification
community review is read-only and revisions are recorded
implementation_steps: 同步 M0/M0.2 8/8 和 M1 0/10 truth
记录官方/社区来源与逐项 disposition
刷新并复核当前 import/vendor HEAD 与 skills.lock.json parity
运行 build/focused/planning/full ordered gates
复核 lock/generated/Git/truth boundary 并提交本逻辑切片
rollback: 只撤销 M0.2 文件与 evidence；不修改 M0/P5 历史、M1 样本、runtime/config/host 状态
done_when: SMV-MD-001 through SMV-MD-008 are done
M0 and M0.2 evidence groups are valid
new and old planning verifiers pass
full gate passes once
M1 remains collecting 0/10 and P6 remains hold
